cluster_label: btl-GAL4 positive female cell, cluster 2, likely to be ovary cell
working_definition: Female cells recovered in the btl-GAL4 trachea sample that the authors judge likely to be ovary cells (Li et al. 2022, Fly Cell Atlas). Authors gave 'Manual Annotation' (no FBbt id); no cell type is named beyond ovary origin.
searches_performed: btl-GAL4 positive female cell, cluster 2, likely to be ovary cell
justification: The authors commit only to 'ovary cell' (uncertain origin). FBbt has no generic cell-level term for a cell of the ovary; somatic cell of ovariole (FBbt:00006030) would exclude germline cells and exceed the authors' commitment, and ovary/ovariole terms are structures, not cells.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Somatic cell that is part of the ovariole. This does not include the ovarian sheath.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Narrower than the authors' 'ovary cell' (excludes germline and sheath cells); would over-commit.

recommendation: Hold: no adequate cell-level FBbt term for a generic ovary cell.
